methodology_note: The review's grading model matches the snapshot. Every load-bearing computation I re-ran (reward recomputations for 017-022 and 028, card-value comparisons for 002/003/006/024/025, and DB replays for 010, 015, 026, 027 and 028) reproduced, and every quote I checked exists in the cited document; the only citation issue is one quote in 017 that drops words without an ellipsis. Blind spots: (1) severities for paired tasks (026/027 vs 028/029) were set per reviewer instead of per defect class; (2) task_014 treats one of two conflicting scenario-specific documents as controlling and then calls the gold unsupported, which overstates it to Blocker; its claim that 014 and 015 cannot both be passed is wrong, because 015 tolerates a transfer offer; (3) cosmetic document corruptions on deciding values are recorded unevenly across tasks. The unflagged sample (002, 003, 004, 012, 015) held up under a from-scratch audit, with no missed defects.
